run_EpochBasedTrainLoop: run epoch-based training loop with configurable max epochs and validation interval
run_IterBasedTrainLoop: run iteration-based training loop with a fixed number of total iterations
run_ValLoop: run validation loop that evaluates model metrics on a validation dataloader
run_TestLoop: run test loop that evaluates model predictions and computes test metrics
review_InfiniteDataloaderIterator: review the infinite dataloader iterator wrapper that auto-resets on StopIteration
